messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Shiny Server on EC2
parts:
All,

I had been working on setting up a private Shiny Server on EC2 and thought I'd go ahead and document the process in case anyone else might benefit. I installed it on Amazon's custom Linux AMI, which required slight modification of how I had installed R and used Upstart previously.

The whole process is documented here: http://trestletechnology.net/2013/02/deploying-shiny-server-on-amazon-ec2/ , or you can just boot up the AMI directly; the name is "ShinyServer."

Let me know if you have any suggestions for the setup guide! I know I went a bit nuclear on the X libraries, but that was leftover from some work I was doing with RGL which did require a litany of X packages. I may go clean those up on the AMI in the future...

Jeff
